name: Specific Local Objectives Point (DLR)
description: Specific Local Objectives Point (DLR) — published by Dún Laoghaire-Rathdown County Council.

OBJECTIVES: Any integration of / or connectivity between the Central Mental Hospital lands with the adjoining residential area should include the development of enhanced sporting facilities/ infrastructure for existing and future residents

Any redevelopment of the Goat site should include the creation of a village square/civic space and a new pedestrian friendly street and should improve the appearance, quality and overall function of the public realm within the area.

It is the objective of Dún Laoghaire-Rathdown County Council to actively support and facilitate the redevelopment and expansion of strategic medical-hospital uses, services and ancillary facilities at the National Rehabilitation Hospital lands.
Permeability through all developments on the west side of Main Street should ensure pedestrian/cycle links between Main Street and the Dundrum Bypass.
That no residential or commercial building development be permitted on this site, in recognition of its close proximity to Booterstown Marsh SPA and pNHA.

That the future uses associated with Dún Laoghaire Carnegie Library explore the option of community use, ensure active street frontage, make a positive contribution to the public realm and takes cognisance of its Protected status.

The Council will assist the Dublin Mountain Partnership to facilitate enhancements to the public Right- of-way between Scalp Villa, Enniskerry Road and Ballybetagh Road, as part of the Dublin Mountains Way.
Through the Council’s membership of the Dublin Mountains Partnership (DMP), to improve the recreation potential of the public lands in the Dublin Mountains.
To accord with the policies of the Woodbrook/Shanganagh Local Area Plan.
To accord with the policies of the adopted Blackrock Local Area Plan.
To accord with the policies of the adopted Goatstown Local Area Plan.
To accord with the policies of the adopted Kiltiernan/ Glenamuck Local Area Plan.
To accord with the policies of the adopted Stillorgan Local Area Plan.
To accord with the policies of the adopted Woodbrook/ Shanganagh Local Area Plan
To complete a Local Area Plan for Dundrum.
To conserve and protect Carrickmines Castle site and to proceed to implement the Carrickmines Castle Conservation Plan 2015-2025.
To conserve the Bride’s Glen as a public amenity.
To continue the development of Shanganagh Park in accordance with the Masterplan, and to develop a sports facility and improved recreational facilities in the park.
To continue to develop the existing sports facilities at the site known as the ‘8-acre field’.
To create a linear park along the Loughlinstown river incorporating a pedestrian route and cycleway (greenway), which will link Cabinteely Park to the sea at Rathsallagh.
To develop Blackrock Park in accordance with a Masterplan approved by the Council.
To develop a Sandyford Business District Civic Park at the corner of Corrig Road and Carmanhall Road.
To encourage and support the development of Seaweed Baths on the former Dún Laoghaire Baths site

To encourage the redevelopment and refurbishment of the former Killiney Beach Tea Rooms in accordance with the zoning objective for the site to include a tea-room/café/restaurant use as part of any proposal on site.
To encourage the redevelopment of ‘The Gut’ adjacent to the West Pier to include improved access to the area
To encourage the retention and development of the Airfield Estate for educational, recreational, tourism, cultural and community uses.

To ensure any future redevelopment of the Old Shopping Centre site addresses the need for the provision of a future Dundrum Community, Cultural and Civic Centre facility, which also integrates into a civic square/plaza area.

To ensure the continued development of a regional park, the conservation of Fernhill House and the preservation of trees, woodlands and amenity gardens at Fernhill in accordance with the approved Masterplan and the Fernhill Sustainability Strategy.
To ensure the provision of pocket parks and civic spaces in accordance with locations specified on Map 1 and Drawing no.10 of the Sandyford Urban Framework Plan.
To ensure the provision of pocket parks and civic spaces in accordance with locations specified on the Sandyford Urban Framework Plan (SUFP).

To establish a new pedestrian walkway that retains the established permeability from the N11 through the lands at St Laurence to the Wyattville Park estate in Loughlinstown. A walkway shall be retained until this specific new SLO is achieved.
To facilitate completion of the unfinished Block and allow consideration of a maximum of 110 residential units.
